name: Uraxii
description: Skills and agents for software development work.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: If you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence. Ported from cursor/plugins/pstack to Claude Code. Original pstack by Lauren Tan (poteto).

plugins.name: artifact
plugins.description: Explain a code change as a self-contained interactive HTML page.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Reach Notion from the command line, and publish a code-change explainer as a Notion page.

plugins.name: azure
plugins.description: Read Azure DevOps projects, repos, pipelines, releases, and work items over the REST API.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Keep research findings in a searchable project knowledgebase instead of re-deriving them.

plugins.name: proton
plugins.description: Read and store secrets in Proton Pass through pass-cli, so none lands in a repo or a shell history.

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Give an agent a throwaway podman container with its own clone of the repo, ports, and a virtual display.

plugins.name: mpocock
plugins.description: Compact a conversation into a handoff document another agent can pick the work up from.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Review and author SKILL.md files, finding and repairing the smells that stop a skill triggering.

plugins.name: codebase-memory
plugins.description: Query a code graph through the codebase-memory-mcp server, skill, and graph-verification agents.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Answer in a compressed register that drops filler and keeps every technical fact.

plugins.name: steer
plugins.description: Harness hooks that steer agent behaviour, independent of any skill.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: Shunts large reads to small subagents and boilerplate generation to Portal AiKA to save main-agent context tokens.

plugins.name: personal-instructions
plugins.description: Inject a hand-edited instructions.md at session start and, where the harness has a subagent-start hook, subagent start.
